summary: Unpinned github: dependency resolves attacker-controllable code at install time
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency with an off-registry source: `"fca-unofficial": "github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial"`, with no commit SHA or tag pin. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever currently lives at the referenced repository's default branch — unpinned and integrity-unchecked — and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in it. The module is also actively `require()`d by the shipped source (e.g. src/api/socket/e2ee/index.js and src/api/socket/e2ee/vendor/fme/dist/index.cjs), so the fetched bytes are loaded in-process at import time as well. Whoever controls that GitHub repository controls what executes on the installer's machine. The other static matches (Buffer.from base64 and `ping` keyword hits) occur inside the package's own E2EE/vendor code and are consistent with normal cryptographic serialization and keep-alive handling, not independent attack signals.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
